answer: With a Dedicated device bound by DNS record proof with a public binding record, the account is only as strong as its binding: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the DNS record proof is recorded, and a public binding record keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so losing the channel means losing the identity, and fakes cannot hide behind throwaway channels. The record keeps every delta visible, so anyone can audit the binding roll. When the tundra settles over the ocean, the binding holds because every channel answered its own challenge.
